crossRefs.note: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall…
I told them of the hand of my God which was good on me, as also of the king’s words that he had spoken to me. They…
Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
Your words have supported him who was falling, You have made firm the feeble knees.
but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.
Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
Strengthen the weak hands, and make the feeble knees firm.
Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong! Don’t be afraid! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s…
Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of…
but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Horesh
people.line: A wilderness area where David hid from Saul

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose, and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.
translations.bsb: And Saul’s son Jonathan came to David in Horesh and strengthened his hand in God,
translations.kjv: And Jonathan Saul's son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.
translations.asv: And Jonathan, Saul's son, arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.
